rule: No new project/evidence/generated artifact may exceed 25 MB.
oversizeDisposition: Split deterministically into numbered chunks below 25 MB plus a manifest containing ordering, original logical name, total bytes, chunk hashes and reassembly instructions.

pushCadence.minimum: push at least every 5 completed phases
pushCadence.protectedUserChanges: Never stage or commit pre-existing user modifications unless explicitly reconciled.
